title: The tuning-target table (GEN.503): the published statistics the tunable draws are tuned to
note: One entry per published statistic. A tunable row of the possibility tables must have a target here (TargetTable.require). A value measured only in the Solar System is a test-point with the solar_system flag, never a target. Labels: READ, DATA, COMPUTED, 2ND-HAND may be tuned to; SNIPPET, RECALLED and NOT REACHED are listed and never tuned to. Source: docs/design/tunable-gaps.md.

targets.statistic: mean of the reported median of log10 fO2 above the iron-wuestite buffer (dIW) of the rocky material that polluted white dwarfs, 22 values
targets.source: Doyle 2020 Table 1 and Doyle 2023 Table 4 (22 values, 2 upper limits left out): mean -1.25, standard error 0.10 (tunable-gaps.md section 3.2, group3-redox-wd-radio.md; the worker computed it and the tunable-gaps lane re-ran it)
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a mean of the reported dIW (the draw through the white-dwarf detection model, error model fitted to the whole sample or to the stars with both bounds) more than 2 sigma from -1.25 over 3000 seeds

targets.statistic: sample standard deviation of the reported median dIW over the same 22 polluted white dwarfs
targets.source: Doyle 2020 Table 1 and Doyle 2023 Table 4: sample sd 0.45 (intrinsic about 0.22 from 13 well-constrained stars); sigma = 0.45 / sqrt(2 x 21), computed here
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a sample sd of the reported dIW (the draw through the white-dwarf detection model with the error fitted to the stars with both bounds) more than 2 sigma from 0.45 over 3000 seeds; the error fitted to the whole sample over-disperses and fails at every width (3.3 sigma at 0.05), so it is not the model this target is tuned with (docs/design/wd-pollution-detection.md)

targets.source: Doyle 2020 Table 1 and Doyle 2023 Table 4: mean -1.25, standard error 0.10 (tunable-gaps.md section 3.2)
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a mean of the reported dIW (the draw through the white-dwarf detection model, error model fitted to the whole sample or to the stars with both bounds) more than 2 sigma from -1.25 over 3000 seeds

targets.statistic: sample standard deviation of the reported median dIW over the same 22 polluted white dwarfs
targets.source: Doyle 2020 Table 1 and Doyle 2023 Table 4: sample sd 0.45; sigma = 0.45 / sqrt(2 x 21), computed here
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a sample sd of the reported dIW (the draw through the white-dwarf detection model with the error fitted to the stars with both bounds) more than 2 sigma from 0.45 over 3000 seeds; the error fitted to the whole sample over-disperses and fails at every width (3.3 sigma at 0.05), so it is not the model this target is tuned with (docs/design/wd-pollution-detection.md)

targets.statistic: median of the heavy-element enrichment Zp/Z* of warm giants at 0.1 M_J
targets.source: Chachan 2025 (arXiv 2509.20428): Zp/Z* = a/Mp + b with a 2.6 +/- 0.3, b 3.3 +/- 0.5 (Mp in M_J), 147 warm giants, 0.03 to 12 M_J; value at 0.1 MJ, error from a and b added in quadrature
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a median of the drawn Zp/Z* more than 2 sigma from the 147-giant fit over 2000 seeds

targets.statistic: median of the heavy-element enrichment Zp/Z* of warm giants at 1.0 M_J
targets.source: Chachan 2025 (arXiv 2509.20428): Zp/Z* = a/Mp + b with a 2.6 +/- 0.3, b 3.3 +/- 0.5 (Mp in M_J), 147 warm giants, 0.03 to 12 M_J; value at 1.0 MJ, error from a and b added in quadrature
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a median of the drawn Zp/Z* more than 2 sigma from the 147-giant fit over 2000 seeds

targets.statistic: median of the heavy-element enrichment Zp/Z* of warm giants at 10.0 M_J
targets.source: Chachan 2025 (arXiv 2509.20428): Zp/Z* = a/Mp + b with a 2.6 +/- 0.3, b 3.3 +/- 0.5 (Mp in M_J), 147 warm giants, 0.03 to 12 M_J; value at 10.0 MJ, error from a and b added in quadrature
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a median of the drawn Zp/Z* more than 2 sigma from the 147-giant fit over 2000 seeds

targets.statistic: sample standard deviation of log10 of the heavy-element enrichment of giants at one mass (intrinsic scatter of the heavy-element mass)
targets.source: Thorngren 2016 (arXiv 1511.07854): intrinsic spread factor 1.82 +/- 0.09 of the heavy-element mass, 47 giants; log10 band 0.238 to 0.281 (COMPUTED); Chachan 2025 agrees (0.22 to 0.29 dex)
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a sample sd of the drawn log10 Zp/Z* more than 2 sigma from 0.26 over 2000 seeds

targets.statistic: median C/O of the giant planets with a retrieved C/O
targets.source: LExACoM (Lothringer, Lowson and Fu 2025, arXiv 2510.26785; public table of 2026-08-28), 69 unique giant planets with a retrieved C/O: median 0.57 (0.42 transit, 0.69 eclipse, 0.58 direct imaging); sigma = 1.25 x 0.27 / sqrt(69)
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a median of the drawn C/O more than 2 sigma from 0.57 over 2000 seeds; the median carries a method systematic of 0.2 to 0.3

targets.statistic: share of the giant planets with a retrieved C/O below 0.35
targets.source: LExACoM (Lothringer, Lowson and Fu 2025, arXiv 2510.26785; public table of 2026-08-28), 69 unique giant planets with a retrieved C/O: 12 of 69 below 0.35
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a share below 0.35 more than 2 sigma from 12/69 over 2000 seeds

targets.statistic: share of the giant planets with a retrieved C/O above 0.8
targets.source: LExACoM (Lothringer, Lowson and Fu 2025, arXiv 2510.26785; public table of 2026-08-28), 69 unique giant planets with a retrieved C/O: 6 of 69 above 0.8 (Wilson 95 percent 0.040 to 0.177); 3 of 69 if the 1-sigma lower bound must exceed 0.8
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a share above 0.8 more than 2 sigma from 6/69 over 2000 seeds; the planets above 0.8 are hot and ultra-hot, so chemistry, retrieval systematics and formation are mixed

targets.statistic: sample standard deviation of the C/O of the giant planets with a retrieved C/O
targets.source: LExACoM (Lothringer, Lowson and Fu 2025, arXiv 2510.26785; public table of 2026-08-28), 69 unique giant planets with a retrieved C/O: sd 0.27 (transit 0.38, eclipse 0.18, direct imaging 0.12); sigma = 0.27 / sqrt(2 x 68) plus a method allowance
targets.label: COMPUTED
targets.falsifier: a sample sd of the drawn C/O more than 2 sigma from 0.27 over 2000 seeds
